title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
abstract: arXiv:2611.28158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. translated_title: 测量并教导语言模型智能体对延迟后果采取行动
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地被要求执行持续数天的运营工作，而非完成孤立的单轮任务。在日常运营中，今天的决策会重塑后续的观察结果和现金约束：空货架会掩盖流失的进店需求，被短缺发货的顾客会在数周后悄然缩减未来的订单，而紧急采购则会消耗营运资金。我们提出了 SMB Bench，这是一个经过校准的 90 天批发模拟器，包含 18 个因果配对任务和一个 859 次运行的前沿模型轨迹数据集，用以探究何种经验和学习信号能让智能体在未见过的业务中更好地察觉、归因并对其自身决策的延迟后果采取行动。在 16 个前沿模型中，只有 3 个模型的表现优于固定的采购规则；模型往往在笔记中记录了相关的诊断，却没有及时据此改变后续的采购行为，这表明诊断问题、改变行为和改善业务是三种相互独立的成就。为……
tldr: 该论文提出 SMB Bench——一个包含 18 个因果配对任务的 90 天批发模拟基准，发现 16 个前沿模型中仅 3 个优于固定采购规则，并揭示模型虽能诊断问题却难以将诊断及时转化为行为改变与业务改善。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks, showing that only 3 of 16 frontier models beat a fixed buying rule and that models often record correct diagnoses in notes without translating them into timely behavioral changes or business improvements.
